Name of Religion: Serafin-Dourism (often just called Serafinism)
Date of Origin: Some time around 1860-1880, also changed somewhat in the early 1900's with the integration of the Swabati Kingdom
About: 
God(s): One goddess, Serafin, although there are helpers called Quintalas, who are relegated to roles similar to lesser gods in other religions.

Beliefs: This religion focuses on hard work, devotion, charity, and being a net positive in the "Market of Life." The Market of Life is focused on charity, understanding of how the afterlife and living world are connected, and how to avoid "turning something into nothing."
